system.description:
Once per Doom Cycle, try to bring one dead ally back to life, even in Nightmare Mode: roll your Smarts Pool. With 1 success they return with 1 Health Point; on a failure they are lost forever.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.48
system.summary: Once per Doom Cycle, try to bring one dead ally back to life, even in Nightmare Mode: roll your Smarts Pool. With 1 success they return with 1 Health Point; on a failure they are lost forever.

automation.onSuccess: The targeted ally returns to life with 1 Health Point.

automation.note: Target the dead ally's token before rolling. On a failure they can never be revived.
